announcements.headline: CEO and MD, Gerteric Lindquist, comments on the Interim Report 3, 2026
announcements.insight: As a major European heat pump manufacturer, NIBE's Q3 interim update is critical for gauging demand resilience amid the UK and EU energy transition policies and potential subsidy shifts. The commentary will likely highlight inventory normalization and margin pressures in a competitive residential heating market.

announcements.headline: NIBE to acquire the business of Italian Beltrami Felice S.r.l. as a going concern
announcements.insight: This acquisition expands NIBE's footprint in the Italian heat pump market, aligning with EU decarbonisation mandates and diversifying revenue streams beyond its Nordic core, though the financial materiality remains limited relative to total group turnover.
